segments.name: Traceability
segments.description: Provides technology-enabled food and consumer product traceability, anti-counterfeit tools and carbon emissions management for organisations, plus carbon project development.
segments.evidence: As a result of the assessment made by the CODM, the Company has only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay for traceability through service fees, technology enhancements, data analytics and IT consultancy; carbon project development earns fees, credit sales and government partnership arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from traceability solutions through service-based fees, technology enhancements, data analytics, and IT consultancy services.
